notes.title: Update Nov. 24, 2017
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
In-Game
Fixed a problem where the 'Ninja' character was facing to the mouse cursor, ignoring the controller input.
Miscellaneous
Fixed an issue where the game still started from the final stage, when the game was restarted after clearing it.
